```
from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "Normalize DNA samples to 10 ng/ul in 50 ul", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    # Tip racks
    p20_tiprack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    p300_tiprack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 2)
    # Plates
    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 3)
    dest_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 4)
    # Reservoir for water
    water_reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 5)
    # Pipettes
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[p20_tiprack])
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[p300_tiprack])

    # Define liquids
    water = protocol.define_liquid(name="water", description="Water for diluent", display_color="#0000FF")
    # Define sample liquids
    for i in range(1, 25):
        protocol.define_liquid(name=f"sample {i}", description=f"Sample {i}", display_color="#FF0000")

    # Load liquids into source plate wells (first 24 wells) with 100 ul each
    source_wells = list(source_plate.wells())[:24]
    for i, well in enumerate(source_wells):
        well.load_liquid(liquid=f"sample {i+1}", volume=100)

    # Load water into reservoir well A1 with 2000 ul
    water_reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid="water", volume=2000)

    # Normalisation calculation
    norm = normalise(
        concentrations=[85,120,44,67,210,95,33,150,78,60,101,55,190,72,48,130,88,25,64,110,39,175,92,58],
        target=10,
        final_volume_ul=50
    )
    samples = norm["samples"]

    # Transfer diluent then sample for each of the 24 samples
    for i in range(24):
        # Get volumes
        sample_vol = samples[i]["sample_ul"]
        diluent_vol = samples[i]["diluent_ul"]

        # Destination well
        dest_well = dest_plate.wells()[i]

        # Transfer diluent with p300
        p300.pick_up_tip()
        p300.aspirate(diluent_vol, water_reservoir["A1"])
        p300.dispense(diluent_vol, dest_well)
        p300.drop_tip()

        # Transfer sample with p20
        p20.pick_up_tip()
        source_well = source_plate.wells()[i]
        p20.aspirate(sample_vol, source_well)
        p20.dispense(sample_vol, dest_well)
        p20.drop_tip()

    # Protocol complete
    return
```

    # Load labware

    p20_tiprack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    p300_tiprack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 2)

    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 3)

    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[p300_tiprack])

    # Define liquids
    water = protocol.define_liquid(name="water", description="Water for diluent", display_color="#0000FF")
    # Define sample liquids
    for i in range(1, 25):

    source_wells = list(source_plate.wells())[:24]

    water_reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid="water", volume=2000)

        diluent_vol = samples[i]["diluent_ul"]

        # Destination well
        dest_well = dest_plate.wells()[i]

        # Transfer diluent with p300
        p300.pick_up_tip()
        p300.aspirate(diluent_vol, water_reservoir["A1"])
        p300.dispense(diluent_vol, dest_well)
        p300.drop_tip()

        # Transfer sample with p20
        p20.pick_up_tip()
        source_well = source_plate.wells()[i]
        p20.aspirate(sample_vol, source_well)
        p20.dispense(sample_vol, dest_well)
        p20.drop_tip()

    # Protocol complete
    return"}

from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {"protocolName": "Normalize DNA samples to 10 ng/ul in 50 ul", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    # Tip racks
    p20_tiprack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    p300_tiprack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 2)
    # Plates
    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 3)
    dest_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 4)
    # Reservoir for water
    water_reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 5)
    # Pipettes
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[p20_tiprack])
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[p300_tiprack])

    # Define liquids
    water = protocol.define_liquid(name="water", description="Water for diluent", display_color="#0000FF")
    # Define sample liquids and load them into source plate wells
    sample_liquids = []
    for i in range(1, 25):
        liq = protocol.define_liquid(name=f"sample {i}", description=f"Sample {i}", display_color="#FF0000")
        sample_liquids.append(liq)
    # Load sample liquids into source plate wells (first 24 wells) with 100 ul each
    source_wells = list(source_plate.wells())[:24]
    for i, well in enumerate(source_wells):
        well.load_liquid(liquid=sample_liquids[i], volume=100)

    # Load water into reservoir well A1 with 2000 ul
    water_reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=water, volume=2000)

    # Volumes to transfer for each sample (sample_ul, diluent_ul)
    # Values from normalisation calculation
    sample_volumes = [
        {"sample_ul": 5.88, "diluent_ul": 44.12},
        {"sample_ul": 4.17, "diluent_ul": 45.83},

        {"sample_ul": 5.26, "diluent_ul": 44.74},
        {"sample_ul": 15.15, "diluent_ul": 34.85},
        {"sample_ul": 3.33, "diluent_ul": 46.67},
        {"sample_ul": 6.41, "diluent_ul": 43.59},
        {"sample_ul": 8.33, "diluent_ul": 41.67},
        {"sample_ul": 4.95, "diluent_ul": 45.05},
        {"sample_ul": 9.09, "diluent_ul": 40.91},
        {"sample_ul": 2.63, "diluent_ul": 47.37},
        {"sample_ul": 6.94, "diluent_ul": 43.06},
        {"sample_ul": 10.42, "diluent_ul": 39.58},
        {"sample_ul": 3.85, "diluent_ul": 46.15},
        {"sample_ul": 5.68, "diluent_ul": 44.32},
        {"sample_ul": 20.00, "diluent_ul": 30.00},
        {"sample_ul": 7.81, "diluent_ul": 42.19},
        {"sample_ul": 4.55, "diluent_ul": 45.45},
        {"sample_ul": 12.82, "diluent_ul": 37.18},
        {"sample_ul": 2.86, "diluent_ul": 47.14},
        {"sample_ul": 5.43, "diluent_ul": 44.57},
        {"sample_ul": 8.62, "diluent_ul": 41.38},
    ]

    # Transfer diluent then sample for each of the 24 samples
    for i in range(24):
        # Get volumes
        sample_vol = sample_volumes[i]["sample_ul"]
        diluent_vol = sample_volumes[i]["diluent_ul"]

        # Destination well
        dest_well = dest_plate.wells()[i]

        # Transfer diluent with p300
        p300.pick_up_tip()
        p300.aspirate(diluent_vol, water_reservoir["A1"])
        p300.dispense(diluent_vol, dest_well)
        p300.drop_tip()

        # Transfer sample with p20

        source_well = source_plate.wells()[i]

    return

metadata = {"protocolName": "Normalize DNA samples to 10 ng/ul in 50 ul", "apiLevel": "2.19"}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Load labware
    # Tip racks
    p20_tiprack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", 1)
    p300_tiprack = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", 2)
    # Plates
    source_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 3)
    dest_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_200ul_flat", 4)
    # Reservoir for water
    water_reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_12_reservoir_15ml", 5)
    # Pipettes
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[p20_tiprack])
    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[p300_tiprack])

    # Define liquids
    water = protocol.define_liquid(name="water", description="Water for diluent", display_color="#0000FF")
    # Define sample liquids and load them into source plate wells
    sample_liquids = []
    for i in range(1, 25):
        liq = protocol.define_liquid(name=f"sample {i}", description=f"Sample {i}", display_color="#FF0000")
        sample_liquids.append(liq)
    # Load sample liquids into source plate wells (first 24 wells) with 100 ul each
    source_wells = list(source_plate.wells())[:24]
    for i, well in enumerate(source_wells):
        well.load_liquid(liquid=sample_liquids[i], volume=100)

    # Load water into reservoir well A1 with 2000 ul
    water_reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=water, volume=2000)

    # Volumes to transfer for each sample (sample_ul, diluent_ul)
    # Values from normalisation calculation
    sample_volumes = [
        {"sample_ul": 5.88, "diluent_ul": 44.12},
        {"sample_ul": 4.17, "diluent_ul": 45.83},
        {"sample_ul": 11.36, "diluent_ul": 38.64},

        {"sample_ul": 3.33, "diluent_ul": 46.67},
        {"sample_ul": 6.41, "diluent_ul": 43.59},
        {"sample_ul": 8.33, "diluent_ul": 41.67},
        {"sample_ul": 4.95, "diluent_ul": 45.05},
        {"sample_ul": 9.09, "diluent_ul": 40.91},
        {"sample_ul": 2.63, "diluent_ul": 47.37},
        {"sample_ul": 6.94, "diluent_ul": 43.06},
        {"sample_ul": 10.42, "diluent_ul": 39.58},
        {"sample_ul": 3.85, "diluent_ul": 46.15},
        {"sample_ul": 5.68, "diluent_ul": 44.32},
        {"sample_ul": 20.00, "diluent_ul": 30.00},
        {"sample_ul": 7.81, "diluent_ul": 42.19},
        {"sample_ul": 4.55, "diluent_ul": 45.45},
        {"sample_ul": 12.82, "diluent_ul": 37.18},
        {"sample_ul": 2.86, "diluent_ul": 47.14},
        {"sample_ul": 5.43, "diluent_ul": 44.57},
        {"sample_ul": 8.62, "diluent_ul": 41.38},
    ]

    # Transfer diluent then sample for each of the 24 samples
    for i in range(24):
        # Get volumes
        sample_vol = sample_volumes[i]["sample_ul"]
        diluent_vol = sample_volumes[i]["diluent_ul"]

        # Destination well
        dest_well = dest_plate.wells()[i]

        # Transfer diluent with p300
        p300.pick_up_tip()
        p300.aspirate(diluent_vol, water_reservoir["A1"])
        p300.dispense(diluent_vol, dest_well)
        p300.drop_tip()

        # Transfer sample with p20
        p20.pick_up_tip()
        source_well = source_plate.wells()[i]

    # Protocol complete

    p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[p300_tiprack])

    # Define liquids
    water = protocol.define_liquid(name="water", description="Water for diluent", display_color="#0000FF")
    # Define sample liquids and load them into source plate wells
    sample_liquids = []
    for i in range(1, 25):
        liq = protocol.define_liquid(name=f"sample {i}", description=f"Sample {i}", display_color="#FF0000")
        sample_liquids.append(liq)
    # Load sample liquids into source plate wells (first 24 wells) with 100 ul each
    source_wells = list(source_plate.wells())[:24]

        {"sample_ul": 7.81, "diluent_ul": 42.19},
        {"sample_ul": 4.55, "diluent_ul": 45.45},
        {"sample_ul": 12.82, "diluent_ul": 37.18},
        {"sample_ul": 2.86, "diluent_ul": 47.14},
        {"sample_ul": 5.43, "diluent_ul": 44.57},
        {"sample_ul": 8.62, "diluent_ul": 41.38},
    ]

    # Transfer diluent then sample for each of the 24 samples
    for i in range(24):
        # Get volumes
        sample_vol = sample_volumes[i]["sample_ul"]

checks.check_report:
protocol.py: 1 biology problem (1 warning).

1. WARNING UNMIXED-AT-END: 22 wells never mixed after sample 1, sample 2, sample 3, sample 4
and 18 more went in (5 to 26% of the well)
   line 82:  p20.dispense(sample_vol, dest_well)
   At line 82 the robot added sample 1, sample 2, sample 3, sample 4 and 18 more to wells
   A1, A2, A3, B1, B2, C1, C2, C3 and 14 more in slot 4, which already held water (this line
   did it 22 times). The addition was 5 to 26% of the well, nothing mixed the well
   afterwards, and the run ended with them that way. Two liquids layered in a small well do
   not mix on their own, so what the well holds is not at the concentration you calculated.
   The liquid added last is a sample, so nothing else in the workflow will mix it: a
   normalisation or a pool left like this is not what it says it is.
   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, B1, B2, C1, C2, C3 and 14 more in slot 4.
   Fix: Mix wells A1, A2, A3, B1, B2, C1, C2, C3 and 14 more in slot 4 after line 82:
   `mix_after=(5, 40)` on the transfer, or `pipette.mix(5, 40, well)`, with the volume about
   80% of what the well holds.
   Source: Artel: automated liquid handlers as sources of error
           https://www.bioprocessintl.com/assays/automated-liquid-handlers-as-sources-of-error
   Source: Illumina: normalising library concentrations (pipette up and down 10 times to
   mix)
           https://support.illumina.com/ko-kr/bulletins/2017/03/best-practices-for-manually-normalizing-library-concentrations.html
   Source: Thermo PowerTrack user guide (a reaction plate not mixed well gives variable
   replicates)
           https://documents.thermofisher.com/TFS-Assets/LSG/manuals/MAN0018825_PowerTrackSYBRGreenMasterMix_UG.pdf
   Source: Integra: how to perform serial dilutions
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applicationguide/master-art-pipetting-and-learn-how-perform-serial-dilutions-our-comprehensive-guide
   [4d2691711fe4]

The Opentrons simulator (8.8.2) passed this protocol with no error: it checks that the robot
can make the moves, not what they do to the liquids.
